Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 31 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Anjali - 56 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
2. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The village well - Day

[Karan stands by the well. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Karan draws water from the well with the rope.]

Karan: "I knew it!"

[Karan drinks water from his cupped hands.]

Karan (laughing): "Well done!"

[Karan splashes water on his face at the well.]

Karan: "One more time!"

[Karan grinds wheat on the stone hand-mill.]

Anjali: "That's great!"

[Karan churns butter in the earthen pot.]

Anjali (excited): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The ghat - Day

[Karan stands on the ghat. Anjali stands near him.]

Karan: "Mom, look over here."

[Karan drowns in the river.]

Anjali (excited): "We have to be strong now."
